candidates.exact_span: The results of all influent and effluent analyses performed pursuant to Part II(A)(1)(c) above
candidates.computation_change_reason: The cross-reference to Part II(A)(1)(c) defines which influent and effluent analyses are in scope; resolving that referenced monitoring schedule determines which monitoring requirements were applicable (B) and which reported results are expected versus absent or insufficient (C).

candidates.exact_span: The monthly average water quality based effluent concentration necessary to meet the state water quality standards as developed in the approved technically based local limits.
candidates.computation_change_reason: This passage ties effluent concentrations to state water quality standards through approved technically based local limits; whether it states an enforceable numeric limit, a derived reporting value, or a limit applicable only to certain dischargers affects which discharge limits are selected for comparison (A).

candidates.exact_span: All effluent monitoring conducted in accordance with Part (II) (A) (1) (c) above shall meet the Minimum Quantification Levels (MQLs) shown in MQL's at Appendix A of Part II below.
candidates.computation_change_reason: MQL compliance is a monitoring-quality condition tied to Part II(A)(1)(c) effluent monitoring; interpretation of which monitoring is covered, what Appendix A MQLs require, and whether results below MQL are usable changes applicable monitoring obligations (B), whether numeric values can be compared to limits (A), and whether missing or sub-MQL data constitutes documented no-data versus inadequate evidence (C).

candidates.exact_span: Any new introduction of pollutants into the treatment works from an indirect discharger which would be subject to Sections 301 and 306 of the Act if it were directly discharging those pollutants
candidates.computation_change_reason: This condition-triggered notice obligation depends on whether a new indirect discharge would be subject to Sections 301 and 306; different readings of that trigger change which permit conditions and follow-on monitoring or reporting requirements were applicable during FY2025 (B).

candidates.exact_span: Any substantial change in the volume or character of pollutants being introduced into the treatment works by a source introducing pollutants into the treatment works at the time of issuance of the permit.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Applicability hinges on what counts as a substantial change in pollutant volume or character and which sources qualify; resolving those terms changes whether associated notice—and any linked monitoring or reporting conditions—were required for evaluated periods (B).
